generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a full Python CLI simulator at [main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) with standard-library-only code and the required entrypoint:

```bash
python output/main.py --input <gcode_file> --output <result_file> [options]
```

What’s included:
- RS274 line parsing (words, comments, expressions, parameter reads/writes, modal-group checks, block delete, `%` file demarcation).
- Machine-state execution for:
  - G0/G1/G2/G3, G4, G10, G17/18/19, G20/21, G28/G30, G38.2
  - G40/41/42, G43/G49, G53, G54–G59.3, G61/G61.1/G64
  - G80, G81–G89, G90/G91, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3, G93/G94, G98/G99
  - M0/M1/M2/M30/M60, M3/M4/M5, M6, M7/M8/M9, M48/M49
  - F/S/T handling and order-of-execution behavior.
- Tool table loading (`--tool-table`) in RS274 section 2.3 format.
- Parameter file input/output (`--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`) in RS274 section 3.2.1 style, including persisted runtime changes.
- Probe-box/probe-tool behavior for G38.2 (`--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`).
- Final result JSON written on both success and error.
- Trace JSON (`--trace-output`) with:
  - `initial_state`
  - time-ordered delta entries
  - required stepping modes (`--trace-time-step` / `--trace-distance-step` / `--trace-position-tolerance`)
  - error location fields on failure.

I also validated with multiple smoke tests (success path, trace sampling, parameter semantics, M2 termination, error path, probe non-trip behavior, trace-argument validation).

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
